newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang Maritime repairs floating hotel.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang Maritime repairs floating hotel.

text.p: Sembawang Maritime Ltd (SML) said on Wednesday it had won a contract to transport and repair the Saigon floating hotel anchored in Ho Chi Minh city.
It said in a statement it would move the hotel to a Singapore shipyard and then send it to its next destination, the Pacific island diving centre of Palau.
Renovations and mechanical repairs in SML's shipyard were expected to be completed in July, it said.
The refurbished 186-room hotel, owned by Japan's EIE International Corp, will be redeployed as a five-star floating resort hotel, the statement said.
SML did not disclose the amount of the contract.
